methods.description: Write an integer over one and apply the rational-number definition.
Use decimal place value or percentage out of one hundred to obtain a fraction with integer numerator and denominator.
Identify a recurring decimal by an equivalent fraction; continuing digits do not imply irrationality. No recurring-decimal algebra method is introduced.
Apply rational and irrational definitions with familiar square roots, pi and its rational approximation.
